title: Shine On, Harvest Moon

evidence.note: Wikipedia states the song debuted in the Ziegfeld Follies of 1908, crediting Nora Bayes (music) and Jack Norworth (lyrics), with sheet music dated 1908.
Library catalog record for the original sheet music lists it as 'New York: Jerome H. Remick & Co., 1908,' crediting composer Nora Bayes and lyricist Jack Norworth.
evidence.source: York University Libraries (John Arpin Sheet Music Collection)

famous_use: Laurel and Hardy's song-and-dance routine in the 1939 RKO film The Flying Deuces.
